pages.text:
A heated press that cures Raw Rubber with Sulfur into Rubber. It runs on heat (HU), no FE, and only at 140°C or hotter: a Firebox at its back is the simplest start, a Fuel Burner or a hot Heat Cell keeps it hotter.
- 2 Raw Rubber + 1 Sulfur Dust make 2 Rubber in 10 seconds, at 12 HU/t.
- Two input slots, each holding one kind of item: hoppers and conduits sort them.
- Sides: input on top, output underneath and heat at the back by default; change them in the Sides tab.
- Speed and Heat upgrades.
